section4.content: Coupons are provided as-is and may be subject to expiration dates, terms, and conditions set by the respective businesses. VibePeek is not responsible for the validity, availability, or redemption of any coupons.

section5.content: Businesses are responsible for the accuracy of their coupon information. All coupons submitted by businesses are subject to review and approval by VibePeek administrators.

section6.title: 6. Membership
section6.content: Membership subscriptions are billed on a recurring basis. You may cancel your membership at any time, but refunds are subject to our refund policy.

section7.content: In no event shall VibePeek or its suppliers be liable for any damages (including, without limitation, damages for loss of data or profit, or due to business interruption) arising out of the use or inability to use the materials on VibePeek.

section8.content: VibePeek may revise these terms of service at any time without notice. By using this website you are agreeing to be bound by the then current version of these terms of service.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us for support. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and payment information.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use the information we collect to:
section2.item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
section2.item2: Process transactions and send related information
section2.item3: Send you technical notices, updates, and support messages
section2.item4: Respond to your comments, questions, and requests

section3.title: 3. Information Sharing
section3.content: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances: with your consent, to comply with legal obligations, or to protect our rights and safety.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

section5.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
section5.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our service and hold certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. You can do this through your account settings or by contacting us directly.

section7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
section7.content: Our service is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
section8.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the 'Last Updated' date.
